episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her strategies for using YouTube as a powerful lead generation tool, having generated over $150 million in sales. She discusses her lead conversion system, including the importance of Zoom consults and exploratory trips to filter serious buyers. Sarah also introduces the showing agent model as a solution for managing multiple clients efficiently.
